interface.shortDescription: Reusable discipline for AI coding agents
interface.longDescription: Apply Lauren Tan's GrokBot coding discipline: clean the codebase before AI copies it, encode rules in lint/tests instead of comments, turn repeated mistakes into CI guards, keep one standard pattern per job, verify through one reusable CLI, and maintain a Feature Map.
